Ann: Hi everyone! Welcome to Cozy Talks. I’m Ann. George: And I’m George. Today, we talk about comfort food in the fall.
Ann: I really love cinnamon and nutmeg. When I bake with them, the house smells so lovely. George: Oh yes, I know that smell! My favorite is apple pie. It’s sweet and rich. Do you like pies? Ann: Yes, I do! But for me, pumpkin soup is better. It’s creamy and salty. It makes me feel warm. George: Mmm, that sounds good. I usually drink hot chocolate in the evening. It’s creamy too, and very sweet. Ann: Nice! Do you like spicy drinks? George: Sometimes. I drink ginger tea. It’s spicy, but I like it in cold weather. Ann: I also eat cabbage soup in the fall. It’s a bit sour, but tasty. George: Really? I don’t eat it much. I prefer mashed potatoes. They are soft and salty. Ann: Mashed potatoes are great! But I love mac and cheese even more. It’s creamy and cheesy—my favorite comfort food. George: Haha, I see we both like creamy food. Fall is really the season for tasty dishes. Ann: That’s true. Thanks for listening, everyone. See you next time!

parts.html:
Ex 1.3 Read the text and choose the main idea

<h3>Warm, Tasty, Happy: Your Comfort Food Guide</h3><p>We all need comfort food sometimes. Had a bad day? Feeling a little sick? Missing home? Comfort food can help.</p><p>Comfort food can be many things: soup, pie, pasta, or even hot chocolate. It is warm, tasty, and makes you feel good.</p><p>What is your favorite comfort food? Everyone is different. Some people love sweet desserts, some love salty soups or creamy pasta.</p><p>Here are some tips for a cozy feeling:</p><p><strong>Serve food hot.</strong> Hot soups make you feel warm inside. Try chicken soup or pumpkin soup on a cold night.</p><p><strong>Cook foods from your childhood.</strong> Foods you ate as a child can make you feel happy and relaxed. Apple pie, mac and cheese, or mashed potatoes can bring back good memories.</p><p><strong>Enjoy food with others.</strong> Comfort food is even better when you share it. Eat pizza with friends, or drink hot chocolate with family.</p><p><strong>Ideas for this fall</strong></p><p>Chicken Noodle Soup – warm, salty, and simple.</p><p>Apple Pie – sweet and cozy.</p><p>Mac and Cheese – creamy, cheesy, and filling.</p><p>Homemade Pizza – cheesy and fun to eat together.</p><p>Comfort food is for everyone. It makes you happy, warm, and relaxed. Try your favorite dish this fall and enjoy the comfort it brings!</p>
